title: Returned-Payment Fees on Home Comfort Financing — Relief by Account Age
content:
*Care centre training notes — the returned-payment fee and the age of a Home Comfort Financing account.*

**What relief does the age of the account give?** The returned-payment account-age relief is 10 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, 5 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

**How is age measured?** In whole months from the funded date to the date of handling.

**How does it reach the fee?** It is one of the returned-payment reliefs, which are added together into the returned-payment relief percentage; the scheduled returned-payment fee is reduced once by that total, never one relief after another.

| Account age | Relief |
|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | 10 percent |
| 12 to 35 whole months | 5 percent |
| under 12 whole months | zero |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).** 11 whole months, zero; 12 whole months, 5 percent; 35 whole months, 5 percent; 36 whole months, 10 percent.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A scheduled fee of $15.00 on an account 40 whole months old, with a further returned-payment relief of 30 percent also applying: the reliefs total 40 percent, and the fee is $15.00 multiplied by 60 and divided by 100, $9.00.
